# Response fixtures

These reduced, anonymized fixtures have recorded provenance from read-only checks
on 2026-10-13 against `/docs/Index/CH_BGer/last`, `/docs/Jobs/CH_BPatG/last`,
`/_search.php`, and `/docs/Facetten.json`.
The sort array is a synthetic Elasticsearch cursor example.
Paths, checksums, counts and action/status coverage are synthetic; field locations
and types follow the live responses. They are contract examples, not snapshots
of the complete court collections or evidence of current endpoint freshness.
No court text or personal data is retained. Field mappings and parsing behavior
are documented in [API-DOCUMENTATION.md](../../API-DOCUMENTATION.md).
